objective: Emulate the old 88de4bb09 full-pack mmap cache-key behavior more closely by disabling GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_PREFILL_PROFILE entirely, not by pointing it at /dev/null.

why_this_diff_matters.old_88de_code: No ONE_PREFILL_PROFILE, one_prefill_key_mode_enabled, or one_cache_key_for code exists in ggml/src/ggml-cuda/moe_stream.cu at 88de4bb09. Cache keys are pointer-based src0_data values.
why_this_diff_matters.current_devnull_rejection: The /dev/null no-prefill run disabled prefill but kept one_prefill_key_mode_enabled() true, so cache keys were named tensor/expert hashes, not pointer keys. It reached only 3.9 tok/s.
why_this_diff_matters.hypothesis: If the old 5.1 diagnostic depended on pointer-key cache behavior rather than just absence of prefill, omitting GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_PREFILL_PROFILE entirely should move current-source counters and token rate closer to the old diagnostic.

method.base_env: same as full-pack mmap no-prefill rejected run

theoretical_bound.upper_signal: The old diagnostic with binary b14646-88de4bb09 reached 5.1 tok/s.
theoretical_bound.expected_best_case: Pointer-key no-prefill current source approaches the old 5.1 result while keeping RAM and TTFT valid.
theoretical_bound.expected_failure: If file-cache pressure remains near 15GB and fallback_t0 stays around 1.5 ms/call, token rate will remain <=4.4 and this route is rejected.

acceptance.ram: memory_peak_bytes <= 16000000000 including page cache, MemorySwapMax=0, no OOM or ram_limit_killed
acceptance.correctness: France output must be semantically correct and coherent
acceptance.promotion: If it passes, record a SOTA-candidate artifact, commit/push immediately, then run clean pushed-source reproduction before accepted SOTA promotion.

rejection: If eval_tok_s <=4.4 or any gate fails, record as rejected and continue the 88de regression audit rather than resampling.
